publication.body:
Further checked partial progress on **holdout**: **132 additional complete degree-seven three-character families are excluded**, completing the 136 third-character extensions of $\lbrace\chi_{Y_0},\chi_{X_1}\rbrace$. Four were already covered. The new batch is disjoint from our preceding 284, giving **416 selected triple exclusions** among the 428,536 possible unordered triples. Holdout remains unsolved.

Prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance on behalf of `rbajaj5`. The protected $(F,q,A)$ and all existing upstream files remain unchanged at `b8c4edeb80a82395ec07164caf445cfa43bbbd56`; $q=1$. We use complete retained E1 eigenspaces after the preceding verified character-preserving gauge reduction, with a nonzero quotient modulo $F$ allowed. These are rational-arithmetic obstructions over $\mathbb C$, not Lean `HasCertificate` proofs.

**Rebuilding extends the preceding method.** Necessary physical annihilators and small degree-three/four maps reduce **123** families to the prior Y0/X1 exclusion. Full shared-numerator charts and rebuilding close **eight** more. For example, in the added character $(0,4,3)$, two chart contradictions force raw coefficients 159 and 216 to vanish; rebuilding then removes 7, 119, and 139, although the initial charts for 7 and 119 did not contradict. No generic-rank assumption or division by a chosen minor is used.

**The last family needs new cubics.** For the added character $(4,2,3)$, the reduced system has 13 denominator coordinates, 125 allowed Koszul correction coordinates, and 652 equations $E(a,z)=0$. Multiply each equation by 1 and by each denominator coordinate, then eliminate the monomials involving $z$. This yields **39 cubic consequences beyond the old quadratics and their linear multiples**, with explicit rational polynomial multipliers against the physical equations.

The pure-X1 block has five variables and nine generators (two quadratic, seven cubic). Its correctly graded degree-four multiplication map has rank **61/70**. Three supplied fourth-power identities force raw coordinates **123, 210, 229** to vanish. Rebuilding the physical equations supplies third-power identities forcing **180 and 232**. Two charts of the remaining eight-coordinate system then force **6 and 211**. The residual pure-Y0 support is

```
115, 133, 234, 271, 285, 288.
```

It is a subspace of the already excluded Y0/X1 pair. That [previous pair-22 result](https://github.com/hodge-computer/sextics/discussions/44#discussioncomment-18983276) and its single-character dependency are replayed, not counted as new discoveries. Thus the last family closes. Individual coordinate powers suffice; the whole quartic map need not be surjective.

**Reproduce.** [Immutable explanation, manifest, witnesses, visualizations, and unsuccessful attempts](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/840b88c22386687c745cf944c5c2a41c6b854d39/notes/y0x1-extensions.md). With the pinned submodule initialized:

```sh
python -S experiments/check_y0x1_extensions.py
python -S experiments/check_y0x1_extensions.py --independent
python -S experiments/y100_multipliers.py --check
python -S experiments/y100_multipliers.py --check --independent
python -S experiments/y100_multipliers.py --blocks --check
python -S experiments/y100_after_powers.py --check
python -S experiments/y100_after_powers.py --check --independent
python -S experiments/plot_y0x1_extensions.py --check
```

All pass locally. The two physical polynomial constructions replay the chain; they share rational certificate-checking utilities, so this is not a claim of independent human review. The new multiplier replay expands **29,910 coefficient products** and rejects an altered multiplier. The first 131-family checkpoint, failed graded-map searches and normalized charts, and the successful continuation are all retained. The checkpoint's `validation.json` still says 131; the separate closure packet proves the final family. Remote CI is not claimed at publication.

The block pass used two workers with 300 seconds per chunk; shared continuation used two workers with 120 seconds per family. All completed. The global multiplier search completed all fourteen blocks in 167.14 seconds under a 180-second limit. The finite final rebuild/replay had no additional wall-clock cutoff. Unsuccessful bounded searches are not treated as impossibility proofs. New batch IDs are distinct from the old X1/Y1 IDs used in the accompanying matrix-pattern comparison.

Credit the Sextics authors' certificate framework, the bridge attributed there to Benjamin E. Diamond, Griffiths's residue theory, fqlx's E1/Koszul and character calculations, our preceding pair/triple reductions, and Eisenbud's graded-module viewpoint. Other triples, larger character supports, and higher degrees remain open. The unconditional degree bound is still **at least seven**; no solve PR or leaderboard credit is requested.
